evidence: Current source reads/edits and manual reference review only. No builds, tests, syntax checks, project/helper/game execution, GPU/JNI calls, process inspection, attachment or export
problem: The native observer captured selected wing transforms and shader values, but final wing palettes had no archive role and the replay color/material consumer admitted only capes

sourcePort.role: WING_SLOT=8 is an archive discriminator, never an engine child-component slot. Admission requires the actual selected MeshRole.Elytra, exact geometry.elytra identity, accepted current WingPose and matching animation frame
sourcePort.paletteSpace: A real child binding preserves its checked pose space; a root wing layer uses the same current model draw as both sides of the existing root conversion. The existing indexed hierarchy/group/owner/name/cache guards remain required
sourcePort.capture: The existing final-current-palette observer and ledger now retain wing palettes along with attachment/cape palettes. Partial, conflicting or unconsumed collections remain incomplete
sourcePort.archive: bedrock_attachment_samples_v3, magic 0x4152434154540003, admits the wing role. The v2 cape and v1 attachment readers remain explicit alternatives; new samples are not silently written into older formats
sourcePort.bounds: Existing 16 palettes, 128 total bones, eight bones per palette, 256 native bone index, 2 MiB history block, 16 MiB replay resident/plan budget and 8 MiB serialized plan limits remain
sourcePort.playback: The serialized Java plan selects exact recorded wing palette samples and optional independently recorded layer color/dithering/shader values. Unknown colors are omitted rather than supplied from the viewer
sourcePort.nativePaletteConsumer: native_emote_upload applies the existing exact replay target to real current-output buffers. Historical entries keep their existing supplied-history semantics. Root wings bypass emote torso retargeting when no recorded palette is selected
sourcePort.nativeMaterialConsumer: native_skinned_desc matches the actual copied description root, tint, selected wing palette and source spans, then copies archived RGBA/dithering to that owned output. native_shader_consumer admits the same wing/frame identity and uses its existing pinned synchronous stack-local material-copy path
sourcePort.materialGuards: The source shader cohort, selected concrete material/path/variation guards, actual description and current palette spans are rechecked before/after copy. Globals, material programs, native texture references and descriptor contents are not modified
sourcePort.receipts: Separate elytraReplayColor/conflict state and nativeWingReplayColor carry exact actor/world/animation/replay identity, source/applied RGBA, flag and shader-copy counts. Cape receipts retain their default role for legacy input. One missing or failed matching description cannot be hidden by a successful later draw
sourcePort.recordAfterReplay: LayerColorSample consumes either cape or wing applied receipts when rerecording; complete copied shader cohorts are distinguished from original live values and incomplete copies
sourcePort.readiness: This code does not promote GPU, complete material, deterministic export or full parity flags; existing wing export limitations remain

remaining: Runtime validation of the installed selected wing hierarchy, palette and synchronous material consumer
Complete native wing texture/program/participant fidelity and deterministic video proof
Java-equivalent entity material producer and native insertion for Arctic-owned custom world meshes
Complete emote/equipment, cape, cosmetics and replay parity verification
